title: AI Blog-to-Social Post Transformer
short: Turn a blog post into three LinkedIn posts and five tweets, or a CSV of articles into one LinkedIn post and one tweet per row.
cost: Paid per use on your own OpenAI account. Roughly 5 cents per article with chat-latest, or about $1 for a CSV of 50 full-length articles. With gpt-6-luna it is well under 1 cent per article.
inputs: Pasted article text, or a CSV with a Content column (URL and Title columns are used when present)
outputs: Editable LinkedIn posts and tweets with character counts, plus generated-social-posts.csv with URL, Title, LinkedIn Post and Tweet columns
how: Paste your OpenAI API key and choose a model. The key stays in your browser and goes only to OpenAI.
Paste one article, or switch to the CSV tab and upload a file with a Content column.
Set the options: emojis, hashtags, audience, voice and an optional call to action.
Generate, then edit any post in place and copy it.
For a CSV, download the results file when the run finishes.
note: The model is told to stay faithful to the article, but it can still overstate or invent a detail, so read every post against the source before you publish it.
